name: const unsafe fn write_unaligned < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
rule: When constructing `dst` for an unaligned field of a packed struct, do not create an intermediate unaligned reference, even temporarily before casting it to a raw pointer; use `&raw mut` instead. The resulting raw pointer may be used with `write_unaligned`.
api: const unsafe fn write_unaligned < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
expression: Cannot express this requirement in the supplied DSL: it has no observation for intermediate references or pointer-construction history.
